_comment: Config for board_setup_audit — the deterministic gate for step 5 (Board Setup). Read-only: parses the .kicad_pro (design_settings.rules + via_dimensions + net_settings) and the sibling .kicad_pcb, and asserts every constraint sits at or above the fab floor × safety margin, vias are arithmetically sound, and every power net is assigned a class. It does NOT write rules — set_design_rules does that (the generator); this proves the result is legal. Cached; RESTART backend after edits. Verdict in words (feedback_no_percentage_scores).
_rule_source: User Board Setup rule set (rules 1,2,5,6,8) + master flow step 5.

rules_vs_fab._rule: Rules 1/2 — each design_settings.rules min_* value must be >= fab floor (× margin on the geometric keys). A value below the fab floor is unmanufacturable; below floor×margin eats the safety factor.

via_annular._rule: Rule 5 — for every via preset: (via_diameter - drill)/2 >= fab min_annular_ring, drill >= fab min_via_drill, and (if via_aspect_ratio_limit set) board_thickness/drill <= limit. Pure arithmetic.

netclass_coverage._rule: Rules 6/8 — every power-like board net (see power_net_globs) must match a netclass_pattern that assigns it to a non-Default class; a +5V net left on Default is a flag.

class_consistency._rule: Rule 5 — each net class's track_width/clearance/via_diameter/via_drill must be >= the board's own min_* rules, and (via_diameter - via_drill)/2 >= min_via_annular_width. Catches a class looser than the board floor (would fail DRC or make a bad via).

rule_floor_map._comment: .kicad_pro rules key -> [fab_profiles.json key, is_geometric]. is_geometric=true means the rule-2 margin applies. Mirrors set_design_rules._apply_fab_profile field_map + _MARGIN_SCALED_KEYS — that tool is the source of truth; keep in sync.

power_net_globs._comment: Rule 6. A board net whose name matches one of these (fnmatch, case-insensitive) is 'power-like' and must carry a net class. Signals left on Default are fine and never flagged.

via_aspect_ratio_limit._comment: board_thickness / finished_drill must be <= this (fab plating aspect limit). null = skip the check (JLCPCB doesn't publish a single number; 8-10 is typical for standard PTH). Set per project when the fab states one.

verdict.clean: BOARD SETUP VERIFIED — {n} rules >= {fab} floors (x{margin}), vias + classes consistent
verdict.issues: BOARD SETUP NOT CLEAN — {e} error(s), {w} warning(s) vs {fab} (x{margin})
verdict.no_pro: NO BOARD SETUP — .kicad_pro has no design rules; run set_design_rules first
